title: Turn a selection into a distribution
summary: Combine a strict numerical cut with histogram filling, then distinguish selected entries from visible entries.
description: Implement TH1D* build_selected_histogram(const std::vector<double>& values, double threshold). Keep only values strictly greater than threshold and fill them into h_selected with 5 bins covering [0,150].
requirements: Apply the strict condition value > threshold.
Fill each surviving value exactly once and reject every non-survivor.
Do not discard selected values merely because they fall in underflow or overflow.

examples.explanation: The boundary value 50 does not survive a strict > 50 cut.

hints: Decide whether a value survives before calling Fill.
GetEntries counts selected fills even when a selected value lands outside the visible histogram range.
learning_goal: Compose a numerical selection and a histogram while keeping selection semantics separate from histogram range semantics.

curriculum.competency: Apply a numerical selection to a sample, fill only surviving values, and inspect how the selection changed the histogram.
curriculum.misconception: Histogram visibility and selection are the same decision, so an out-of-range selected value should be dropped before Fill.
curriculum.observable_success: The histogram entries match the strict selection while its integral and overflow independently describe where selected values landed.
curriculum.acceptance: Tests jointly verify which values survive, histogram entries, range behavior and selected bin contents.

es.title: Convierte una selección en una distribución
es.summary: Combina un corte numérico estricto con el llenado de un histograma y distingue entradas seleccionadas de entradas visibles.
es.description: Implementa TH1D* build_selected_histogram(const std::vector<double>& values, double threshold). Conserva solo los valores estrictamente mayores que threshold y llénalos en h_selected con 5 bins que cubren [0,150].
requirements: Crea h_selected con 5 bins que cubren [0,150].
Aplica la condición estricta value > threshold.
Llena cada valor que sobrevive exactamente una vez y rechaza los demás.
No descartes valores seleccionados solo porque caigan en underflow u overflow.

examples.explanation: El valor de borde 50 no sobrevive a un corte estricto > 50.

hints: Decide si el valor sobrevive antes de llamar a Fill.
GetEntries cuenta los Fill seleccionados incluso cuando un valor seleccionado cae fuera del rango visible.
es.learning_goal: Componer una selección numérica y un histograma manteniendo separadas la semántica del corte y la del rango.
